## Organization Overview
Keystone Possibilities Ltd. is a premier custom home building, BC Bill 44 multiplex engineering, civil utility contracting, and fiduciary construction management firm headquartered in Squamish, BC (Sea-to-Sky corridor), operating across West Vancouver, North Vancouver, Whistler, Squamish, Pemberton, and Vancouver.

## Master Builder Credentials & Statutory Licensing
- **BC Housing Licensed Residential Builder**: License #52603 (Verified Registry: https://lims.bchousing.org/LicenceExpiryPortal/licence/52603)
- **Mandatory New Home Warranty Protection**: 2-5-10 National Home Warranty Protection (2 years materials/labour, 5 years building envelope, 10 years structural defects)
- **Civil Utility Standard**: BC Hydro Registered Civil Contractor List ES54 (Underground primary/secondary utility ducting, 3-phase PMT vaults, civil trenching & municipal infrastructure)
- **High-Performance Envelopes**: BC Energy Step Code 4 & Step Code 5, Zero Carbon Step Code (EL-4), Passive House Principles
- **Seismic & Structural Engineering**: BC Building Code 2024, Vancouver Building By-law (VBBL Part 10 R-22 Effective), High-Seismic Infill Engineering (Sa=0.94g), Simpson Strong-Tie ATS Continuous Rod Holdown Systems, Stepped Bedrock Footings & Micropiles

## Primary Service Regions
1. **West Vancouver, BC** ($550 – $1,000+ / sq ft):
   - Micro-neighborhoods: British Properties, Caulfeild, Altamont, Dundarave, Ambleside, Hollyburn Ridge
   - Specialization: Granite bedrock blasting & micropiles, steep-slope post-tensioned rock anchors, District of West Vancouver Watercourse Protection Bylaw 4364 (15m riparian setbacks)
2. **North Vancouver, BC**:
   - Edgemont Village, Deep Cove, Lynn Valley, Lonsdale, Upper Delbrook
   - Specialization: BC Bill 44 up-to-6-unit SSMUH multiplex conversions, Step Code 5 custom homes, steep canyon geotechnical foundations
3. **Whistler, BC** ($650 – $1,200+ / sq ft):
   - Micro-neighborhoods: Sunridge Plateau (Ski-In / Ski-Out), Kadenwood, Alta Lake, Green Lake, Blueberry Hill
   - Specialization: High alpine ground snow load roof engineering (12.8 kPa+ / 260+ psf), cold-roof ventilated assemblies, heavy timber post-and-beam, Step Code 5 air-tightness (<1.0 ACH50)
4. **Squamish, BC**:
   - Downtown Squamish, The Heights, Garibaldi Highlands, University Highlands, Finch Drive, Britannia Beach
   - Specialization: BC Bill 44 3-to-6 unit multiplex infill, Flood Construction Level (FCL) structural raft slabs, civil utility servicing
5. **Pemberton, BC**:
   - Pemberton Benchlands, Meadowlark, Pemberton Valley Acreages (SLRD Area C)
   - Specialization: Luxury acreage compounds, continental climate thermal envelopes, off-grid solar/geothermal microgrids, agricultural and alpine estate builds
6. **Vancouver & Sunshine Coast, BC**:
   - Shaughnessy, Point Grey, Kitsilano, Dunbar-Southlands, Sechelt, Gibsons

## Core Services & Offerings
1. **Luxury Custom Estate Construction**: Turnkey design-build contracting, open-book fiduciary transparency, mandatory 2-5-10 National Home Warranty protection.
2. **BC Bill 44 Multiplex Feasibility & Construction**: 3-to-6 unit missing-middle multiplex conversions, zoning & FSR envelope modeling, strata pro-forma engineering.
3. **BC Hydro ES54 Registered Civil Contracting**: Underground civil trenching, pad-mounted transformer (PMT) civil works, municipal water/storm/sanitary upgrades.
4. **Fiduciary Project Management & Owner Representation**: 100% transparent cost-plus accounting, trade tender audits, municipal permit acceleration.
5. **Pre-Acquisition Property Feasibility & Risk Mitigation Retainer**: Site due diligence, bedrock/geotechnical risk assessment, civil utility cost modeling, and zoning verification.
